meta.scope: Iran Batch 5 — Agriculture (wheat focus), defence expenditure, and education/human capital densification.

candidates.title: Agriculture production statistics
candidates.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran / Ministry of Agriculture related
candidates.description: Official volume and value statistics for major crops and livestock. Wheat is the dominant staple; other significant products include barley, pistachios, fruits and related commodities.

candidates.title: Wheat production statistics
candidates.description: Focused statistics on wheat area, yield and production. Wheat is the central food-security crop; production levels interact with imports, subsidies and climate variability.

candidates.title: Defence / military expenditure statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from official budget and international compilations (SIPRI-aligned)
candidates.description: Estimates of military expenditure. Official figures are affected by high inflation (real declines even when nominal rises) and are widely assessed to understate true spending that draws on off-budget oil revenues.
candidates.notes: Core defence-resource node. Interpretation requires care because of off-budget financing.

candidates.title: National defence and security policy framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from defence and strategic sources
candidates.description: Policy and strategic framing of Iran’s defence and security posture, including conventional forces, missile and drone capabilities, and regional influence instruments. Continuously referenced in external and sanctions analysis.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the defence budget node.

candidates.title: Education enrolment and literacy statistics
candidates.description: Enrolment rates by level and literacy rates (including youth and gender-disaggregated figures). Youth literacy is high; overall adult literacy and higher-education attainment form the main human-capital stock indicators.
candidates.notes: Core education access and literacy node.

candidates.title: Iran agriculture–defence–education densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from SCI, defence and education sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and wheat production, defence expenditure and policy framing, and education/literacy statistics into a coherent primary-sector, security and human-capital layer.
